purpose: Represent, connect, retrieve and evolve explicit knowledge with provenance, scope, contradiction and supersession intact without manufacturing domain truth through schema authority.

owns: Source/provenance links, contradiction representation and supersession mechanics.
Knowledge quality/coverage structure and explicit unknowns.
escalates_when: Sources materially conflict and domain adjudication is required.
Retrieval requires private data beyond consent.

minimum_capabilities: Avoid collapsing unknown into null/false silently.
adaptation_rules: Model-generated knowledge stays proposed until sourced/evidenced.
Deterministic transforms may normalize structure but cannot adjudicate domain disagreement automatically.
Retriever ranking is not source authority.

reads: Accepted sources, domain contracts, provenance and access policy.
writes: Knowledge structures, links, retrieval indexes, contradiction/supersession records and gaps.
coordination_contracts: Knowledge representation preserves dissent and source scope.
Private knowledge remains within consent/access boundaries.

retrieval_rules: Preserve source identity and scope with extracted claims.
Prefer direct/authoritative sources appropriate to domain without erasing competing evidence.
uncertainty_rules: Schema completeness is not world completeness.
Conflicting sources remain explicit until adjudicated.

skills.description: Attach claims/structures to source, scope, version and confidence/evidence context.
evidence_required: Round-trip from knowledge item to source is possible.

skills.description: Represent incompatible claims without silent overwrite.
evidence_required: Conflict and adjudication state stay visible.

tools.failure_boundary: Missing provenance blocks canonical truth promotion.
Index miss does not prove knowledge absent.

procedures.trigger: A domain needs explicit reusable knowledge/retrieval structure.
steps: Build retrieval/index path with source links.
Test round-trip, conflict and stale-source behavior.
Hand domain adjudication to owning profession.
stop_conditions: Source/provenance unavailable for required canonical claim.

project: Accepted knowledge schema, sources and supersession history.
working: Candidate mappings and unresolved entity matches.
retention_rules: Keep source/version/supersession links with knowledge state.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose explicit source-linked knowledge structures and updates.

claim_rules: Representation validity is separate from claim truth.
Retrieval rank is separate from source authority.
minimum_for_working: At least two materially different knowledge domains demonstrate stable boundaries.

may_decide: Knowledge representation, indexing and provenance mechanics.

failure_library.symptom: Because ontology has one slot, conflicting real claims are forced into one value.
checks: Inspect source conflicts and cardinality assumptions.

professional_tests.fixture: Two authoritative sources disagree due different jurisdiction/version.
expected_observations: Does not choose winner without domain basis.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Retrieval exposes bounded disagreement and handoff.
